upstream.description: Microsoft Dataverse backend plug-ins generated with   Claude Code and the d365-architect-v3 skill

classification.analysis: DVerseClaudeSkills is the archived v1 seed of the DVerse project: a Claude Code skill (`d365-architect`) that encodes senior-level Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse plugin-development knowledge (event pipeline, best practices, SDK patterns) so Claude Code can generate production-quality plugins, workflow extensions, tests, and docs from plain-English requirements. It includes sample generated output (a PreValidation plugin and a custom workflow activity, both with xUnit/Moq tests). Explicitly archived and superseded by the governed DVerse harness; the repo documents two known build defects (missing signing key, misplaced test globbing) rather than fixing them, since it is preserved only for provenance.
